items.title: West Virginia Legislature — suspected ransomware
items.summary: IT staff spotted unusual activity on internal systems on Nov 19 and shut down systems and remote access as a possible ransomware attack; some systems were still offline the following afternoon.

items.title: Osaki Electric (Japan) — production halted
items.summary: The smart-meter maker found encrypted server data on Nov 17, cut external network links and stopped production systems and shipments; no restart timeline given.

items.title: Advantage Archives — claimed by INC Ransom
items.summary: US professional-services/records firm listed on INC Ransom's leak site, discovered Nov 13; victim has not publicly confirmed.

items.title: Greiz district hospital (Germany) — reported attack
items.summary: Incident tracker lists a ransomware attack on the Greiz district hospital along with an Illinois school district; details are fragmentary and unconfirmed by primary notices.

ransomware.note: Ransomware activity up ~23% year on year per October reporting; several November leak-site claims remain unconfirmed by victims.

items.title: Mid-November cluster: Microsoft 365, FAA, Workday, Chase, United, Apple
items.summary: Between Nov 12 and 17 a run of major outages hit Microsoft 365, the FAA air-traffic network, Workday, JPMorgan Chase, United Airlines and Apple; the M365 event was not logged as an Azure platform incident.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2 (London) power loss
items.summary: Tracker records an ~8-hour zone outage from a utility cable fault at a third-party facility; sources disagree on whether it occurred in October or November.

items.title: Analysis: two weeks of US attacks and outages
items.summary: Review of the overlapping November attacks and service outages finds mostly unrelated causes rather than a coordinated campaign.

outage.note: No confirmed AWS, Azure or Google Cloud platform-wide outage found for November 2026.

items.title: European Commission hit by AI-assisted cyberattack
items.summary: The Commission confirmed an attack that misused a publicly available AI tool and forced several applications offline; most are restored and the investigation continues.

items.title: Cleverbridge payment-card breach
items.summary: The e-commerce platform took systems offline after unauthorized activity on Nov 4 and says card numbers and CVVs stored on its platform were copied.

items.title: CISA warns of active Node2Shell exploitation
items.summary: CISA confirmed attackers are exploiting the critical Node2Shell flaw and added it to the KEV catalog.

items.title: KEV: six flaws incl. Chrome zero-day and Barracuda ESG RCE
items.summary: Nov 10 additions span Outlook, Chrome, Barracuda, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop; Barracuda deadline Nov 13, others Nov 24.

items.title: KEV: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex
items.summary: Four actively exploited flaws added Nov 9 with a Nov 12 patch-and-triage deadline; GPUStack systems may have been compromised before the warning.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure flaws under KEV deadline
items.summary: Two Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities added to KEV with a Nov 13 federal remediation deadline.

items.title: Monadnock Community Hospital cyber incident
items.summary: Hospital reported a cyber incident causing a server outage; no responsible group named and ransomware not confirmed.

items.title: M 6.8 — 105 km NE of Lospalos, Timor-Leste (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS green alert; no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.7 — near Carhuamayo, Peru (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS green alert; tsunami flag set on the event.

items.title: M 6.6 — 149 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia (Nov 16)
items.summary: USGS green alert; no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.5 — Vanuatu region (Nov 23)
items.summary: USGS green alert; tsunami flag set on the event.

items.title: M 5.9 — 238 km SW of Yanglong, China (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS yellow alert — some casualties or damage possible.

items.title: Ecuador flooding
items.summary: Heavy rain left 12 dead, more than 56,000 people affected and nearly 12,800 homes damaged as of Nov 5.

items.title: Santa Catarina, Brazil storms
items.summary: State government logged 671 storm incidents across 76 municipalities on Nov 4–5.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu — Andhra Pradesh, India
items.summary: Made landfall Nov 3, the second cyclone to hit the Andhra Pradesh coast in under a week.

physical.note: Weather items are early-November; no November 2026 wildfire reports found.
